## Round 1 Summary

**What I learned:**

1. **Surrogate massively overestimates high-mutation variants**: The top surrogate predictions (11.3, 10.8, 10.1) turned out to be mostly negative or weakly positive (max 1.7). The surrogate fails to capture negative epistasis in high-mutation space.

2. **High-uncertainty ≠ hidden gems**: All 20 high-uncertainty variants (very different from training data) had negative fitness (-2 to -7). These are simply bad variants in unexplored space.

3. **Random sampling found moderate success**: Testing 13 random variants revealed one at 4.5 fitness (DEEEIRTTNPVATEQYGSVSTGVQRPTR) and a few in the 1-3 range.

4. **Best variant unchanged**: The cold-start best (9.536) remains unbeaten. The measured landscape around it appears well-explored.
